translations.literal: Sun and moon join as paired jades, praising the vast reach of tireless effort; clouds fly and thunder presses near, displaying the subtle intent of flowering pearwood.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon join as paired jades, praising the vast reach of tireless effort. Clouds fly and thunder presses near, displaying the subtle intent of flowering pearwood.

sentences.zh: 若五音之變化，濟九成之妙曲，此朱生得玄珠於赤水，謨神睿以為言。

translations.literal: Like the transformations of the five tones completing the marvelous tune of the Ninefold Completion—this is Master Zhu obtaining the dark pearl from Red Water and taking divine wisdom as his words.
translations.idiomatic: Like the transformations of the five tones completing the marvelous tune of the Ninefold Completion—this is Master Zhu obtaining the dark pearl from Red Water and taking divine wisdom as his words.

sentences.zh: 至夫組織仁義，琢磨道德，歡其愉樂，恤其陵夷，寄通靈台之下，遺跡江湖之上，風雨急而不輟其音，霜雪零而不渝其色，斯賢達之素交，曆萬古而一遇。

translations.literal: As for weaving together benevolence and righteousness, polishing moral power, rejoicing in their pleasure, pitying their decline, lodging beneath the Spirit Terrace, leaving traces upon rivers and lakes—through urgent wind and rain they do not cease their tone, through falling frost and snow they do not change their color—such is the plain friendship of the worthy and eminent, met once in ten thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: As for weaving together benevolence and righteousness, polishing moral power, rejoicing in their pleasure, pitying their decline, lodging beneath the Spirit Terrace, leaving traces upon rivers and lakes—through urgent wind and rain they do not cease their tone, through falling frost and snow they do not change their color—such is the plain friendship of the worthy and eminent, met once in ten thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 逮叔世人訛，狙詐飆起，溪穀不能踰其險，鬼神無以究其變，競毛羽之輕，趨錐刀之末。

translations.literal: When the age of decline came, the world erred, cunning and fraud rose like a whirlwind; streams and valleys could not cross their peril, ghosts and spirits could not trace their changes; men raced after the lightness of feathers and hurried to the tip of awl and knife.
translations.idiomatic: When the age of decline came, the world erred and cunning and fraud rose like a whirlwind. Streams and valleys could not cross their peril, ghosts and spirits could not trace their changes. Men raced after the lightness of feathers and hurried to the tip of awl and knife.

sentences.zh: 於是素交盡，利交興，天下蚩蚩，鳥驚雷駭。

translations.literal: Thereupon plain friendship was exhausted and profit friendship arose; all under heaven was restless, birds startled and thunder-struck.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon plain friendship was exhausted and profit friendship arose. All under heaven was restless, birds startled and thunder-struck.

sentences.zh: 然利交同源，派流則異，較言其略，有五術焉：

translations.literal: Yet profit friendship shares one source but its branches flow differently; comparing them in outline, there are five kinds:
translations.idiomatic: Yet profit friendship shares one source but its branches flow differently. Comparing them in outline, there are five kinds:

sentences.zh: 若其寵均董、石，權壓梁、竇，雕刻百工，爐錘萬物，吐嗽興雲雨，呼吸下霜露，九域聳其風塵，四海疊其熏灼。

translations.literal: "If favor equals Dong and Shi, power presses down Liang and Dou, carving the hundred crafts, smelting the ten thousand things, spitting and coughing raise cloud and rain, breathing in and out sends down frost and dew—the nine regions start at their wind and dust, the four seas are layered with their scorching heat.
translations.idiomatic: If favor equals Dong and Shi, power presses down Liang and Dou, carving the hundred crafts, smelting the ten thousand things, spitting and coughing raise cloud and rain, breathing in and out sends down frost and dew—the nine regions start at their wind and dust, the four seas are layered with their scorching heat.

sentences.zh: 靡不望影星奔，藉響川鶩。

translations.literal: None fail to gaze at their star and run, borrow their echo and flock like ducks on a stream.
translations.idiomatic: None fail to gaze at their star and run, borrow their echo and flock like ducks on a stream.

sentences.zh: 雞人始唱，鶴蓋成陰，高門旦開，流水接軫，皆願摩頂至踵，隳膽抽腸。

translations.literal: When the cock-man first sings, crane-canopies form shade; when the high gate opens at dawn, flowing carriages link wheel hubs—all wish to rub crown to heel, smash gall and draw out entrails.
translations.idiomatic: When the cock-man first sings, crane-canopies form shade. When the high gate opens at dawn, flowing carriages link wheel hubs. All wish to rub crown to heel, smash gall and draw out entrails.

sentences.zh: 約同要離焚妻子，誓殉荊卿湛七族。

translations.literal: They covenant like Yaoli burning wife and children, vow to die with Jing Ke and drown seven clans.
translations.idiomatic: They covenant like Yaoli burning wife and children, vow to die with Jing Ke and drown seven clans.

sentences.zh: 是曰勢交，其流一也。

translations.literal: This is called power friendship; its stream is the first.
translations.idiomatic: This is called power friendship. Its stream is the first.

sentences.zh: 富埒陶、白，貲巨程、羅，山擅銅陵，家藏金穴，出平原而聯騎，居里閈而鳴鍾。

translations.literal: "Wealth rivals Tao and Bai, assets exceed Cheng and Luo; mountains hold copper mines, households hide golden caves; leaving the plain they ride in linked files, dwelling in lanes they ring bells.
translations.idiomatic: Wealth rivals Tao and Bai, assets exceed Cheng and Luo. Mountains hold copper mines, households hide golden caves. Leaving the plain they ride in linked files, dwelling in lanes they ring bells.

sentences.zh: 則有窮巷之賓，繩樞之士，冀宵燭之末光，邀潤屋之微澤。

translations.literal: Then there are guests of poor lanes, men of wicker pivots, hoping for the last light of a night candle, seeking the slight moisture that moistens a house.
translations.idiomatic: Then there are guests of poor lanes, men of wicker pivots, hoping for the last light of a night candle, seeking the slight moisture that moistens a house.

sentences.zh: 魚貫鳧踴，颯遝鱗萃，分雁鶩之稻粱，沾玉斝之餘瀝。

translations.literal: They file like fish, leap like ducks, gather in scales and clusters, share the grain of wild geese and ducks, wet themselves with the lees of jade goblets.
translations.idiomatic: They file like fish, leap like ducks, gather in scales and clusters, share the grain of wild geese and ducks, wet themselves with the lees of jade goblets.

sentences.zh: 銜恩遇，進款誠，援青松以示心，指白水而旌信。

translations.literal: They hold gratitude for favor, advance sincere regard, grasp green pines to show the heart, point to white water to display faith.
translations.idiomatic: They hold gratitude for favor, advance sincere regard, grasp green pines to show the heart, point to white water to display faith.

sentences.zh: 是曰賄交，其流二也。

translations.literal: This is called bribery friendship; its stream is the second.
translations.idiomatic: This is called bribery friendship. Its stream is the second.

sentences.zh: 陸大夫宴喜西都，郭有道人倫東國，公卿貴其籍甚，搢紳羨其登仙。

translations.literal: "Grandee Lu feasted and rejoiced in the Western Capital; Guo the Worthy was the human measure of the Eastern State; dukes and ministers prized his great fame, gentry envied his ascent to immortality.
translations.idiomatic: Grandee Lu feasted and rejoiced in the Western Capital. Guo the Worthy was the human measure of the Eastern State. Dukes and ministers prized his great fame, gentry envied his ascent to immortality.

sentences.zh: 加以顩頤蹙頞，涕唾流沫，騁黃馬之劇談，縱碧雞之雄辯。

translations.literal: Added to this, chin drawn and brow furrowed, tears and spittle flowing in foam, they unleash the fierce talk of the yellow horse and give free rein to the heroic eloquence of the green cock.
translations.idiomatic: Added to this, chin drawn and brow furrowed, tears and spittle flowing in foam, they unleash fierce talk and give free rein to heroic eloquence.

sentences.zh: 敘溫燠則寒谷成暄，論嚴苦則春叢零葉，飛沈出其顧指，榮辱定其一言。

translations.literal: Narrating warmth makes cold valleys turn balmy; discussing severity makes spring thickets drop their leaves; rise and fall come from a glance and gesture, honor and disgrace are fixed by a single word.
translations.idiomatic: Narrating warmth makes cold valleys turn balmy. Discussing severity makes spring thickets drop their leaves. Rise and fall come from a glance and gesture, honor and disgrace are fixed by a single word.

sentences.zh: 於是有弱冠王孫，綺紈公子，道不掛於通人，聲未遒於雲閣，攀其鱗翼，丐其餘論，附騏驥之旄端，軼歸鴻于碣石。

translations.literal: Thereupon there are capping princelings, silk-clad young lords, whose Way does not hang on the accomplished, whose fame has not reached the Cloud Pavilion; they climb their scales and wings, beg their leftover discourse, attach to the mane-tip of the qiji steed, and outpace the returning goose at Jieshi.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon there are capping princelings, silk-clad young lords, whose Way does not hang on the accomplished, whose fame has not reached the Cloud Pavilion. They climb their scales and wings, beg their leftover discourse, attach to the mane-tip of the qiji steed, and outpace the returning goose at Jieshi.

sentences.zh: 是曰談交，其流三也。

translations.literal: This is called talk friendship; its stream is the third.
translations.idiomatic: This is called talk friendship. Its stream is the third.

sentences.zh: 陽舒陰慘，生靈大情，憂合歡離，品物恒性。

translations.literal: "Yang expands, yin constricts—the great feeling of living beings; sorrow joins, joy parts—the constant nature of things.
translations.idiomatic: Yang expands, yin constricts—the great feeling of living beings. Sorrow joins, joy parts—the constant nature of things.

sentences.zh: 故魚以泉涸而呴沫，鳥因將死而鳴哀。

translations.literal: Therefore fish, when the spring dries, bubble foam at one another; birds, because they are about to die, cry in grief.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore fish, when the spring dries, bubble foam at one another. Birds, because they are about to die, cry in grief.

sentences.zh: 同病相憐，綴河上之悲曲，恐懼置懷，昭穀風之盛典，斯則斷金由於湫隘，刎頸起于苫蓋。

translations.literal: Those with the same illness pity one another, stringing the mournful tune of the River; fear placed in the breast displays the great ceremony of Valley Wind—thus severed gold comes from narrow straits, and neck-cutting friendship rises from thatch and cover.
translations.idiomatic: Those with the same illness pity one another, stringing the mournful tune of the River. Fear placed in the breast displays the great ceremony of Valley Wind. Thus severed gold comes from narrow straits, and neck-cutting friendship rises from thatch and cover.

sentences.zh: 是以伍員濯溉於宰嚭，張王撫翼于陳相。

translations.literal: Therefore Wu Yuan was washed and irrigated by Steward Pi; Zhang and Wang stroked wings at the Chancellor of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Wu Yuan was washed and irrigated by Steward Pi. Zhang and Wang stroked wings at the Chancellor of Chen.

sentences.zh: 是曰窮交，其流四也。

translations.literal: This is called destitute friendship; its stream is the fourth.
translations.idiomatic: This is called destitute friendship. Its stream is the fourth.

sentences.zh: 馳鶩之俗，澆薄之倫，無不操權衡，執纖纊，衡所以揣其輕重，纊所以屬其鼻息。

translations.literal: "In the custom of rushing ducks, in the code of thin and shallow men, none fail to wield scales and hold silken threads; the scale is to gauge their weight, the thread is to tie their breath.
translations.idiomatic: In the custom of rushing ducks, in the code of thin and shallow men, none fail to wield scales and hold silken threads. The scale is to gauge their weight, the thread is to tie their breath.

sentences.zh: 若衡不能舉，纊不能飛，雖顏、冉龍翰鳳鶵，曾、史蘭熏雪白，舒、向金玉泉海，卿、雲黼黻河漢，視若遊塵，遇同土梗，莫肯費其半菽，罕有落其一毛。

translations.literal: If the scale cannot lift, the thread cannot fly—though Yan and Ran were dragon pinions and phoenix chicks, Zeng and Shi orchid-scented and snow-white, Shu and Xiang gold-jade springs and seas, Qing and Yun brocade patterns of river and Milky Way—they are viewed as wandering dust, met like clay puppets; none will spend half a bean, rarely will one drop a single hair.
translations.idiomatic: If the scale cannot lift, the thread cannot fly—though Yan and Ran were dragon pinions and phoenix chicks, Zeng and Shi orchid-scented and snow-white, Shu and Xiang gold-jade springs and seas, Qing and Yun brocade patterns of river and Milky Way—they are viewed as wandering dust, met like clay puppets. None will spend half a bean, rarely will one drop a single hair.

sentences.zh: 若衡重錙銖，纊微彯撇，雖共工之搜慝，驩兜之掩義，南荊之跋扈，東陵之巨猾，皆為匍匐委蛇，折枝舐痔。

translations.literal: If the scale weighs a hundredth and the thread is fine as floating fluff—even Gong Gong's search for evil, Huan Dou's concealment of righteousness, the overbearing of southern Jing, the great rogue of eastern tombs—all become crawling and winding, breaking branches and licking hemorrhoids.
translations.idiomatic: If the scale weighs a hundredth and the thread is fine as floating fluff—even Gong Gong's search for evil, Huan Dou's concealment of righteousness, the overbearing of southern Jing, the great rogue of eastern tombs—all become crawling and winding, breaking branches and licking hemorrhoids.

sentences.zh: 金膏翠羽將其意，脂韋便辟導其誠。

translations.literal: Golden ointment and kingfisher feathers carry their intent; grease, leather, and obsequiousness guide their sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Golden ointment and kingfisher feathers carry their intent. Grease, leather, and obsequiousness guide their sincerity.

sentences.zh: 故輪蓋所遊，必非夷、惠之室，包苴所入，實行張、霍之家。

translations.literal: Therefore where carriage wheels and canopies travel is surely not the house of Bo Yi or Hui; where wrapped bundles enter in fact goes to the homes of Zhang and Huo.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore where carriage wheels and canopies travel is surely not the house of Bo Yi or Hui. Where wrapped bundles enter in fact goes to the homes of Zhang and Huo.

sentences.zh: 謀而後動，芒豪寡忒。

translations.literal: They plot before they act; the awn-haired and powerful rarely err.
translations.idiomatic: They plot before they act. The awn-haired and powerful rarely err.

sentences.zh: 是曰量交，其流五也。

translations.literal: This is called measured friendship; its stream is the fifth.
translations.idiomatic: This is called measured friendship. Its stream is the fifth.

sentences.zh: 凡斯五交，義同賈鬻，故桓譚譬之於闤闠，林回諭之于甘醴。

translations.literal: "All these five friendships are in meaning the same as buying and selling; therefore Huan Tan compared them to market stalls, Lin Hui likened them to sweet wine.
translations.idiomatic: All these five friendships are in meaning the same as buying and selling. Therefore Huan Tan compared them to market stalls, Lin Hui likened them to sweet wine.

sentences.zh: 夫寒暑遞進，盛衰相襲，或前榮而後悴，或始富而終貧，或初存而末亡，或古約而今泰。

translations.literal: Cold and heat advance in turn, flourishing and decline succeed one another; some are first honored and later withered, some begin rich and end poor, some at first survive and in the end perish, some anciently constrained and now at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Cold and heat advance in turn, flourishing and decline succeed one another. Some are first honored and later withered, some begin rich and end poor, some at first survive and in the end perish, some anciently constrained and now at ease.

sentences.zh: 回圈翻覆，迅若波瀾，此則徇利之情未嘗異，變化之道不得一。

translations.literal: Turning and revolving, overturning and reversing, swift as waves—here the feeling of pursuing profit has never differed, the Way of change cannot be one.
translations.idiomatic: Turning and revolving, overturning and reversing, swift as waves—here the feeling of pursuing profit has never differed, the Way of change cannot be one.

sentences.zh: 由是觀之，張、陳所以凶終，蕭、朱所以隙末，斷焉可知矣。

translations.literal: Viewed from this, why Zhang and Chen met violent ends, why Xiao and Zhu found rifts at the end—can clearly be known.
translations.idiomatic: Viewed from this, why Zhang and Chen met violent ends and why Xiao and Zhu found rifts at the end can clearly be known.

sentences.zh: 而翟公方規規然勒門以箴客，何所見之晚乎？

translations.literal: Yet Duke Zhai was just then sternly barring his gate to admonish guests—how late was what he saw?
translations.idiomatic: Yet Duke Zhai was just then sternly barring his gate to admonish guests—how late was what he saw?

sentences.zh: 然因此五交，是生三釁：敗德殄義，禽獸相若，一釁也；

translations.literal: Yet from these five friendships three offenses arise: destroying virtue and extinguishing righteousness, resembling beasts—first offense;
translations.idiomatic: Yet from these five friendships three offenses arise: destroying virtue and extinguishing righteousness, resembling beasts—the first offense;

sentences.zh: 難固易攜，讎訟所聚，二釁也；

translations.literal: hard to solidify, easy to carry off, where enmity and litigation gather—second offense;
translations.idiomatic: hard to solidify, easy to carry off, where enmity and litigation gather—the second offense;

sentences.zh: 名陷饕餮，貞介所羞，三釁也。

translations.literal: name falling into gluttony, what the upright and firm are ashamed of—third offense.
translations.idiomatic: name falling into gluttony, what the upright and firm are ashamed of—the third offense.

sentences.zh: 古人知三釁之為梗，懼五交之速尤，故王丹威子以榎楚，朱穆昌言而示絕，有旨哉！

translations.literal: The ancients knew the three offenses as obstruction, feared the five friendships' swift blame; therefore Wang Dan awed his son with the pagoda tree staff, Zhu Mu spoke plainly and displayed severance—how pointed!
translations.idiomatic: The ancients knew the three offenses as obstruction and feared the five friendships' swift blame. Therefore Wang Dan awed his son with the pagoda tree staff, Zhu Mu spoke plainly and displayed severance—how pointed!

sentences.zh: 有旨哉！

translations.literal: How pointed!
translations.idiomatic: How pointed!

sentences.zh: 近世有樂安任昉，海內髦傑，早綰銀黃，夙昭人譽。

translations.literal: "In recent times there was Ren Fang of Le'an, a leading figure within the seas, early girded with silver and yellow, long renowned in human praise.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times there was Ren Fang of Le'an, a leading figure within the seas, early girded with silver and yellow, long renowned in human praise.

sentences.zh: 遒文麗藻，方駕曹、王，英跱俊邁，聯衡許、郭。

translations.literal: Forceful writings and beautiful ornament, driving abreast of Cao and Wang; heroic stride and eminent stride, yoked in balance with Xu and Guo.
translations.idiomatic: Forceful writings and beautiful ornament, driving abreast of Cao and Wang. Heroic stride and eminent stride, yoked in balance with Xu and Guo.

sentences.zh: 類田文之愛客，同鄭莊之好賢。

translations.literal: Like Tian Wen in loving guests, like Zheng Zhuang in delighting in the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Like Tian Wen in loving guests, like Zheng Zhuang in delighting in the worthy.

sentences.zh: 見一善則盱衡扼腕，遇一才則揚眉抵掌。

translations.literal: Seeing one good he raised his brow and clenched his wrist; meeting one talent he lifted his eyebrows and struck his palms.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing one good he raised his brow and clenched his wrist. Meeting one talent he lifted his eyebrows and struck his palms.

sentences.zh: 雌黃出其唇吻，朱紫由其月旦。

translations.literal: Orpiment and realgar came from his lips; vermilion and purple from his monthly dawn judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Orpiment and realgar came from his lips. Vermilion and purple from his monthly dawn judgment.

sentences.zh: 於是冠蓋輻湊，衣裳雲合，輜軿擊轊，坐客恒滿。

translations.literal: Thereupon caps and canopies converged like wheel spokes, robes and garments gathered like clouds, carriage shafts struck wheel hubs, seated guests were constantly full.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon caps and canopies converged like wheel spokes, robes and garments gathered like clouds, carriage shafts struck wheel hubs, seated guests were constantly full.

sentences.zh: 蹈其閫閾，若升闕里之堂，入其隩隅，謂登龍門之阪。

translations.literal: Treading his threshold was like ascending the hall of Que Li; entering his inner corner was called climbing the slope of Dragon Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Treading his threshold was like ascending the hall of Que Li. Entering his inner corner was called climbing the slope of Dragon Gate.

sentences.zh: 至於顧眄增其倍價，翦拂使其長鳴，彯組雲台者摩肩，趨走丹墀者疊跡。

translations.literal: As for a glance doubling their price, trimming and brushing making them cry long—those with floating ribbons at Cloud Terrace rubbed shoulders, those hurrying on the cinnabar court layered footprints.
translations.idiomatic: As for a glance doubling their price, trimming and brushing making them cry long—those with floating ribbons at Cloud Terrace rubbed shoulders, those hurrying on the cinnabar court layered footprints.

sentences.zh: 莫不締恩狎，結綢繆。

translations.literal: None failed to bind favor intimately and knot close friendship.
translations.idiomatic: None failed to bind favor intimately and knot close friendship.

sentences.zh: 想惠、莊之清塵，庶羊、左之徽烈。

translations.literal: They thought of the clear dust of Hui and Zhuang, hoped for the fine blaze of Yang and Zuo.
translations.idiomatic: They thought of the clear dust of Hui and Zhuang, hoped for the fine blaze of Yang and Zuo.

sentences.zh: 及瞑目東粵，歸骸洛浦，繐帳猶懸，門罕漬酒之彥，墳未宿草，野絕動輪之賓。

translations.literal: When he closed his eyes in Eastern Yue and returned his bones to Luopu, the tent curtains still hung but the gate rarely saw the worthy who sprinkled wine; the tomb had not yet overnight grass, the wilds utterly lacked guests whose wheels moved.
translations.idiomatic: When he closed his eyes in Eastern Yue and returned his bones to Luopu, the tent curtains still hung but the gate rarely saw the worthy who sprinkled wine. The tomb had not yet overnight grass, the wilds utterly lacked guests whose wheels moved.

sentences.zh: 藐爾諸孤，朝不謀夕，流離大海之南，寄命瘴癘之地。

translations.literal: Contemptibly small, the orphans did not plan from morning to evening, wandered destitute south of the great sea, entrusted their lives to miasmic lands.
translations.idiomatic: Contemptibly small, the orphans did not plan from morning to evening, wandered destitute south of the great sea, entrusted their lives to miasmic lands.

sentences.zh: 自昔把臂之英，金蘭之友，曾無羊舌下泣之仁，甯慕郈成分宅之德。

translations.literal: From former days the heroes who grasped arms, the friends of golden orchid—never had the benevolence of Yangshe's weeping below, never emulated the virtue of Zou's dividing houses.
translations.idiomatic: From former days the heroes who grasped arms, the friends of golden orchid—never had the benevolence of Yangshe's weeping below, never emulated the virtue of Zou's dividing houses.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 世路嶮歧，一至於此！

translations.literal: The world's road is perilous and forked—to reach this point!
translations.idiomatic: The world's road is perilous and forked—to reach this point!

sentences.zh: 太行孟門，豈云鏩絕。

translations.literal: Taihang and Meng Gate—can one say they are cut off?
translations.idiomatic: Taihang and Meng Gate—can one say they are cut off?

sentences.zh: 是以耿介之士，疾其若斯，裂裳裹足，棄之長鶩。

translations.literal: Therefore upright and firm gentlemen hated it thus, tore their robes to wrap their feet, and cast it off to long flight.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore upright and firm gentlemen hated it thus, tore their robes to wrap their feet, and cast it off to long flight.

sentences.zh: 獨立高山之頂，歡與麋鹿同群，曒曒然絕其雰濁，誠恥之也，誠畏之也。」

translations.literal: Standing alone on the high mountain's peak, they rejoiced to flock with deer, brightly cutting off its murky vapors—truly they were ashamed of it, truly they feared it."
translations.idiomatic: Standing alone on the high mountain's peak, they rejoiced to flock with deer, brightly cutting off its murky vapors—truly they were ashamed of it, truly they feared it."

sentences.zh: 到溉見其論，抵幾於地，終身恨之。

translations.literal: When Dao Gai saw this treatise he struck the table to the ground and hated it for life.
translations.idiomatic: When Dao Gai saw this treatise he struck the table to the ground and hated it for life.

sentences.zh: 昉撰雜傳二百四十七卷，地記二百五十二卷，文章三十三卷。

translations.literal: Fang compiled Miscellaneous Biographies in 247 scrolls, Gazetteers in 252 scrolls, and Literary Writings in 33 scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Fang compiled Miscellaneous Biographies in 247 scrolls, Gazetteers in 252 scrolls, and Literary Writings in 33 scrolls.

sentences.zh: 東裏位尚書外兵郎。

translations.literal: Dongli held the post of Director of External Troops in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Dongli held the post of Director of External Troops in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 王僧孺

translations.literal: Wang Sengru
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sengru

sentences.zh: 王僧孺字僧孺，東海郯人也。

translations.literal: Wang Sengru, courtesy name Sengru, was a native of Tan in Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sengru, styled Sengru, came from Tan in Donghai commandery.

sentences.zh: 魏衛將軍肅八世孫也。

translations.literal: He was the eighth-generation descendant of Su, Guards General of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: He was the eighth-generation descendant of Su, Guards General of Wei.

sentences.zh: 曾祖雅，晉左光祿大夫、儀同三司。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Ya was Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Commissioner Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Ya was Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Commissioner Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies of Jin.

sentences.zh: 祖准之，宋司徒左長史。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zhunzhi was Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education under Song.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zhunzhi was Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education under Song.

sentences.zh: 父延年，員外常侍，未拜卒。

translations.literal: His father Yannian was Attendant Gentleman Outside the Regular Establishment and died before assuming the post.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yannian was Attendant Gentleman Outside the Regular Establishment and died before assuming the post.

sentences.zh: 僧孺幼聰慧，年五歲便機警，初讀孝經，問授者曰：「此書何所述？」

translations.literal: Sengru in youth was clever and keen; at five he was already alert. When he first read the Classic of Filial Piety he asked his instructor, "What does this book describe?"
translations.idiomatic: Sengru in youth was clever and keen. At five he was already alert. When he first read the Classic of Filial Piety he asked his instructor, "What does this book describe?"

sentences.zh: 曰：「論忠孝二事。」

translations.literal: He said, "It discusses the two matters of loyalty and filial piety."
translations.idiomatic: He said, "It discusses the two matters of loyalty and filial piety."

sentences.zh: 僧孺曰：「若爾，願常讀之。」

translations.literal: Sengru said, "If so, I wish to read it always."
translations.idiomatic: Sengru said, "If so, I wish to read it always."

sentences.zh: 又有饋其父冬李，先以一與之，僧孺不受，曰：「大人未見，不容先嘗。」

translations.literal: Someone also presented winter plums to his father; they first gave one to him, but Sengru would not accept it, saying, "Father has not yet seen them—I cannot taste them first."
translations.idiomatic: Someone also presented winter plums to his father. They first gave one to him, but Sengru would not accept it, saying, "Father has not yet seen them—I cannot taste them first."

sentences.zh: 七歲能讀十萬言，及長篤愛墳籍。

translations.literal: At seven he could read a hundred thousand words; when grown he deeply loved the classics.
translations.idiomatic: At seven he could read a hundred thousand words. When grown he deeply loved the classics.

sentences.zh: 家貧，常傭書以養母，寫畢諷誦亦了。

translations.literal: His family was poor; he often copied books to support his mother, and when the copying was done he could also recite them through.
translations.idiomatic: His family was poor. He often copied books to support his mother, and when the copying was done he could also recite them through.

sentences.zh: 仕齊為太學博士，尚書僕射王晏深相賞好。

translations.literal: He served Qi as Erudite of the Imperial Academy; Wang Yan, Vice Director of the Secretariat, deeply appreciated and favored him.
translations.idiomatic: He served Qi as Erudite of the Imperial Academy. Wang Yan, Vice Director of the Secretariat, deeply appreciated and favored him.

sentences.zh: 晏為丹陽尹，召補功曹，使撰東宮新記。

translations.literal: When Yan was Administrator of Danyang he summoned him to fill the post of merit officer and had him compile a New Record of the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan was Administrator of Danyang he summoned him to fill the post of merit officer and had him compile a New Record of the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 司徒竟陵王子良開西邸，招文學，僧孺與太學生虞羲、丘國賓、蕭文琰、丘令楷、江洪、劉孝孫並以善辭藻遊焉。

translations.literal: The Minister of Education, Prince Jingling, opened the Western Lodge and recruited men of letters; Sengru together with the academy students Yu Xi, Qiu Guobin, Xiao Wenyan, Qiu Lingkai, Jiang Hong, and Liu Xiaosun all wandered there for skill in literary ornament.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Education, Prince Jingling, opened the Western Lodge and recruited men of letters. Sengru together with the academy students Yu Xi, Qiu Guobin, Xiao Wenyan, Qiu Lingkai, Jiang Hong, and Liu Xiaosun all gathered there for skill in literary ornament.

sentences.zh: 而僧孺與高平徐夤俱為學林。

translations.literal: Sengru together with Xu Yin of Gaoping were both forest of learning.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru together with Xu Yin of Gaoping were both pillars of the scholarly grove.

sentences.zh: 文惠太子欲以為宮僚，乃召入直崇明殿。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Wenhui wished to make him a palace aide and therefore summoned him to attend directly at Chongming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Wenhui wished to make him a palace aide and therefore summoned him to attend directly at Chongming Hall.

sentences.zh: 會薨，出為晉安郡丞，仍除候官令。

translations.literal: It happened that the prince died; he went out as assistant magistrate of Jin'an commandery and was then appointed magistrate of Houguan.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the prince died. He went out as assistant magistrate of Jin'an commandery and was then appointed magistrate of Houguan.

sentences.zh: 建武初舉士，為始安王遙光所薦，除儀曹郎，遷書侍御史，出為錢唐令。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianwu he was nominated as a scholar; recommended by Prince Yao'guang of Shi'an, he was appointed Gentleman of the Ceremonial Office, transferred to Attending Censor of Documents, and went out as magistrate of Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianwu he was nominated as a scholar. Recommended by Prince Yao'guang of Shi'an, he was appointed Gentleman of the Ceremonial Office, transferred to Attending Censor of Documents, and went out as magistrate of Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 初僧孺與樂安任昉遇于竟陵王西邸，以文學會友，及將之縣，昉贈詩曰：「唯子見知，唯餘知子，觀行視言，要終猶始。

translations.literal: Earlier Sengru and Ren Fang of Le'an met at Prince Jingling's Western Lodge and formed friendship through literature; when he was about to go to the county, Fang presented a poem saying, "Only you know me, only I know you; observing conduct and viewing words, the essential end is still like the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Sengru and Ren Fang of Le'an met at Prince Jingling's Western Lodge and formed friendship through literature. When he was about to go to the county, Fang presented a poem saying, "Only you know me, only I know you. Observing conduct and viewing words, the essential end is still like the beginning.

sentences.zh: 敬之重之，如蘭如芷，形應影隨，曩行今止。

translations.literal: Revere and value you, like orchid like angelica; form answers shadow and follows, former conduct now stops.
translations.idiomatic: I revere and value you, like orchid like angelica. Form answers shadow and follows, former conduct now stops.

sentences.zh: 百行之首，立人斯著，子之有之，誰毀誰譽。

translations.literal: The head of the hundred conducts, in establishing a person thus made manifest; you have it—who will slander, who will praise?
translations.idiomatic: The head of the hundred conducts, in establishing a person thus made manifest. You have it—who will slander, who will praise?

sentences.zh: 修名既立，老至何遽，誰其執鞭，吾為子禦。

translations.literal: Cultivated name already established, old age arrives how swiftly; who will hold the whip? I will drive for you.
translations.idiomatic: Cultivated name already established, old age arrives how swiftly. Who will hold the whip? I will drive for you.

sentences.zh: 劉略班藝，虞志荀錄，伊昔有懷，交相欣勖。

translations.literal: Liu's outline and Ban's craft, Yu's will and Xun's record—in former days we had these thoughts, mutually rejoicing and urging one another.
translations.idiomatic: Liu's outline and Ban's craft, Yu's will and Xun's record—in former days we had these thoughts, mutually rejoicing and urging one another.

sentences.zh: 下帷無倦，升高有屬，嘉爾晨登，惜餘夜燭。」

translations.literal: Lowering the curtain without weariness, ascending high with what belongs; I praise your morning climb, regret my remaining night candle."
translations.idiomatic: Lowering the curtain without weariness, ascending high with what belongs. I praise your morning climb, regret my remaining night candle."

sentences.zh: 其為士友推重如此。

translations.literal: Thus was he esteemed and pushed forward by scholar-friends.
translations.idiomatic: Thus was he esteemed and pushed forward by scholar-friends.

sentences.zh: 梁天監初，除臨川王后軍記室，待詔文德省。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianjian under Liang he was appointed recorder of the Rear Army for the King of Linchuan and awaited imperial orders at the Wende Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianjian under Liang he was appointed recorder of the Rear Army for the King of Linchuan and awaited imperial orders at the Wende Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 出為南海太守。

translations.literal: He went out as grand administrator of Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as grand administrator of Nanhai.

sentences.zh: 南海俗殺牛，曾無限忌，僧孺至便禁斷。

translations.literal: The custom of Nanhai was to kill cattle without any restriction or taboo; as soon as Sengru arrived he forbade and cut it off.
translations.idiomatic: The custom of Nanhai was to kill cattle without any restriction or taboo. As soon as Sengru arrived he forbade it.

sentences.zh: 又外國舶物、高涼生口歲數至，皆外國賈人以通貨易。

translations.literal: Moreover foreign ships' goods and captives from Gaoliang arrived yearly, all traded by foreign merchants for circulating goods.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover foreign ships' goods and captives from Gaoliang arrived yearly, all traded by foreign merchants for circulating goods.

sentences.zh: 舊時州郡就市，回而即賣，其利數倍，曆政以為常。

translations.literal: In former times the province and commandery went to the market, turned and immediately sold, the profit several times over; successive administrations took this as normal.
translations.idiomatic: In former times the province and commandery went to the market, turned and immediately sold, the profit several times over. Successive administrations took this as normal.

sentences.zh: 僧孺歎曰：「昔人為蜀部長史，終身無蜀物，吾欲遺子孫者，不在越裝。」

translations.literal: Sengru sighed and said, "In former days a man served as chief clerk of the Shu commandery and for life had no Shu goods; what I wish to leave descendants is not in Yue baggage."
translations.idiomatic: Sengru sighed and said, "In former days a man served as chief clerk of the Shu commandery and for life had no Shu goods. What I wish to leave descendants is not in Yue baggage."

sentences.zh: 並無所取。

translations.literal: He took nothing from any of it.
translations.idiomatic: He took nothing from any of it.

sentences.zh: 視事二歲，聲績有聞。

translations.literal: In two years of administering affairs his reputation and achievements were heard of.
translations.idiomatic: In two years of administering affairs his reputation and achievements were heard of.

sentences.zh: 詔征將還，郡中道俗六百人詣闕請留，不許。

translations.literal: An edict summoned him to return; six hundred lay and clerical people of the commandery went to the gate to request he be kept—this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned him to return. Six hundred lay and clerical people of the commandery went to the gate to request he be kept—this was not granted.

sentences.zh: 至，拜中書侍郎，領著作，復直文德省。

translations.literal: When he arrived he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrently Director of Composition, and again attended directly at the Wende Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrently Director of Composition, and again attended directly at the Wende Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 撰起居注、中表簿，遷尚書左丞，俄兼御史中丞。

translations.literal: He compiled the Daily Records and the Register of Central and Outer Relations, was promoted to Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat, and soon concurrently served as Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He compiled the Daily Records and the Register of Central and Outer Relations, was promoted to Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat, and soon concurrently served as Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 僧孺幼貧，其母鬻紗布以自業，嘗攜僧孺至市，道遇中丞鹵簿，驅迫墜溝中。

translations.literal: Sengru in youth was poor; his mother sold gauze cloth for her livelihood; once she took Sengru to the market and on the road met the censor's guard retinue; driven and pressed, they fell into a ditch.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru in youth was poor. His mother sold gauze cloth for her livelihood. Once she took Sengru to the market and on the road met the censor's guard retinue. Driven and pressed, they fell into a ditch.

sentences.zh: 及是拜日，引騶清道，悲感不自勝。

translations.literal: On the day of this appointment he had outriders clear the road and could not overcome his grief and emotion.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of this appointment he had outriders clear the road and could not overcome his grief and emotion.

sentences.zh: 頃之即真。

translations.literal: Before long he assumed the full post.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he assumed the full post.

sentences.zh: 時武帝制春景明志詩五百字，敕沈約以下辭人同作，帝以僧孺為工。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor composed a five-hundred-character poem on spring scenery and clear intent and ordered Shen Yue and the literary men below to compose together; the Emperor considered Sengru's the most skillful.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Emperor composed a five-hundred-character poem on spring scenery and clear intent and ordered Shen Yue and the literary men below to compose together. The Emperor considered Sengru's the most skillful.

sentences.zh: 曆少府卿，尚書吏部郎，參大選，請謁不行。

translations.literal: He successively served as Minister of the Palace Storehouses and Director of the Ministry of Personnel in the Secretariat, participated in the great selection, and requests for audience did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as Minister of the Palace Storehouses and Director of the Ministry of Personnel in the Secretariat, participated in the great selection, and requests for audience did not succeed.

sentences.zh: 出為仁威南康王長史、蘭陵太守，行府、州、國事。

translations.literal: He went out as chief clerk to the King of Nankang, Benevolent and Martial, and grand administrator of Lanling, acting in the princely establishment, commandery, and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as chief clerk to the King of Nankang, Benevolent and Martial, and grand administrator of Lanling, acting in the princely establishment, commandery, and state affairs.

sentences.zh: 初，帝問僧孺妾媵之數，對曰：「臣室無傾視。」

translations.literal: Earlier the Emperor asked Sengru the number of his concubines; he replied, "In my household there is no sidelong glance."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Emperor asked Sengru the number of his concubines. He replied, "In my household there is no sidelong glance."

sentences.zh: 及在南徐州，友人以妾寓之，行還，妾遂懷孕。

translations.literal: When he was in South Xuzhou a friend lodged a concubine with him; when he returned from his journey the concubine was already pregnant.
translations.idiomatic: When he was in South Xuzhou a friend lodged a concubine with him. When he returned from his journey the concubine was already pregnant.

sentences.zh: 為王典簽湯道湣所糾，逮詣南司，坐免官，久之不調。

translations.literal: He was impeached by the prince's chief clerk Tang Daomin, was taken to the southern bureau, was punished by dismissal from office, and for a long time was not reassigned.
translations.idiomatic: He was impeached by the prince's chief clerk Tang Daomin, was taken to the southern bureau, was punished by dismissal from office, and for a long time was not reassigned.

sentences.zh: 友人廬江何炯猶為王府記室，僧孺乃與炯書以見其意。

translations.literal: His friend He Jiong of Lujiang still served as recorder of the princely establishment; Sengru thereupon wrote Jiong a letter to show his intent.
translations.idiomatic: His friend He Jiong of Lujiang still served as recorder of the princely establishment. Sengru thereupon wrote Jiong a letter to show his intent.

sentences.zh: 後為安成王參軍事，鎮右中記室參軍。

translations.literal: Later he served as aide to the King of Ancheng and recorder-aide in the Central Office of the Pacification Right.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served as aide to the King of Ancheng and recorder-aide in the Central Office of the Pacification Right.

sentences.zh: 僧孺工屬文，善楷隸，多識古事。

translations.literal: Sengru was skilled at composing prose, good at regular and clerical script, and knew many ancient matters.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru was skilled at composing prose, good at regular and clerical script, and knew many ancient matters.

sentences.zh: 侍郎全元起欲注素問，訪以砭石。

translations.literal: Attendant Gentleman Quan Yuanqi wished to annotate the Plain Questions and consulted him about stone needles.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Gentleman Quan Yuanqi wished to annotate the Plain Questions and consulted him about stone needles.

sentences.zh: 僧孺答曰：「古人當以石為針，必不用鐵。

translations.literal: Sengru replied, "The ancients surely used stone for needles and certainly did not use iron.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru replied, "The ancients surely used stone for needles and certainly did not use iron.

sentences.zh: 說文有此砭字，許慎云：'以石刺病也。

translations.literal: The Explaining Graphs has this character for stone needle; Xu Shen says, 'to pierce illness with stone.'
translations.idiomatic: The Explaining Graphs has this character for stone needle. Xu Shen says, 'to pierce illness with stone.'

sentences.zh: '東山經：'高氏之山多針石。

translations.literal: The Classic of Eastern Mountains says, 'Mount Gao has many needle stones.'
translations.idiomatic: The Classic of Eastern Mountains says, 'Mount Gao has many needle stones.'

sentences.zh: '郭璞云：'可以為砭針。

translations.literal: Guo Pu says, 'They can serve as stone needles.'
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu says, 'They can serve as stone needles.'

sentences.zh: '春秋：'美疢不如惡石。

translations.literal: The Spring and Autumn Annals says, 'A fine abscess is not as good as a harsh stone.'
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Annals says, 'A fine abscess is not as good as a harsh stone.'

sentences.zh: '服子慎注云：'石，砭石也。

translations.literal: Fu Zishen's commentary says, 'Stone means stone needle.'
translations.idiomatic: Fu Zishen's commentary says, 'Stone means stone needle.'

sentences.zh: '季世無復佳石，故以鐵代之爾。」

translations.literal: In later ages there were no more fine stones, so iron was used in their place."
translations.idiomatic: In later ages there were no more fine stones, so iron was used in their place."

sentences.zh: 轉北中郎諮議參軍，入直西省，知撰譜事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Advisory Aide of the North Central Commandant, entered direct attendance at the Western Secretariat, and managed compilation of genealogical matters.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Advisory Aide of the North Central Commandant, entered direct attendance at the Western Secretariat, and managed compilation of genealogical matters.

sentences.zh: 先是，尚書令沈約以為「晉咸和初，蘇峻作亂，文籍無遺。

translations.literal: Earlier, Director of the Secretariat Shen Yue considered that "at the beginning of Xianhe of Jin, Su Jun raised rebellion and literary records were left with nothing surviving.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Director of the Secretariat Shen Yue considered that "at the beginning of Xianhe of Jin, Su Jun raised rebellion and literary records were left with nothing surviving.

sentences.zh: 後起咸和二年以至於宋，所書並皆詳實，並在下省左戶曹前廂，謂之晉籍，有東西二庫。

translations.literal: Later, from the second year of Xianhe down to Song, what was written was all detailed and true, all kept in the front wing of the Left Household Office of the Lower Secretariat, called the Jin Register, with eastern and western storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: Later, from the second year of Xianhe down to Song, what was written was all detailed and true, all kept in the front wing of the Left Household Office of the Lower Secretariat, called the Jin Register, with eastern and western storehouses.

sentences.zh: 此籍既並精詳，實可寶惜，位宦高卑，皆可依案。

translations.literal: This register being altogether refined and detailed is truly to be treasured; high and low in office and rank can all be traced by the record.
translations.idiomatic: This register being altogether refined and detailed is truly to be treasured. High and low in office and rank can all be traced by the record.

sentences.zh: 宋元嘉二十七年，始以七條徵發，既立此科，人奸互起，偽狀巧籍，歲月滋廣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia of Song they first levied by the seven articles; once this category was established, human deceit arose mutually, false documents and crafty registers grew month by month.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia of Song they first levied by the seven articles. Once this category was established, human deceit arose mutually, false documents and crafty registers grew month by month.

sentences.zh: 以至於齊，患其不實，於是東堂校籍，置郎令史以掌之。

translations.literal: Down to Qi they worried that it was not true; thereupon they collated registers in the Eastern Hall and appointed gentlemen and clerks to manage them.
translations.idiomatic: Down to Qi they worried that it was not true. Thereupon they collated registers in the Eastern Hall and appointed gentlemen and clerks to manage them.

sentences.zh: 競行奸貨，以新換故，昨日卑細，今日便成士流。

translations.literal: They competed in bribery, exchanging new for old; yesterday base and petty, today they became gentry stream.
translations.idiomatic: They competed in bribery, exchanging new for old. Yesterday base and petty, today they became gentry stream.

sentences.zh: 凡此奸巧，並出愚下，不辨年號，不識官階。

translations.literal: All this deceit and craft came from the foolish and lowly, unable to distinguish reign titles, unable to recognize official ranks.
translations.idiomatic: All this deceit and craft came from the foolish and lowly, unable to distinguish reign titles, unable to recognize official ranks.

sentences.zh: 或注隆安在元興之後，或以義熙在甯康之前。

translations.literal: Some placed Long'an after Yuanxing, or placed Yixi before Ningkang.
translations.idiomatic: Some placed Long'an after Yuanxing, or placed Yixi before Ningkang.

sentences.zh: 此時無此府，此時無此國。

translations.literal: At this time there was no such office; at this time there was no such state.
translations.idiomatic: At this time there was no such office. At this time there was no such state.

sentences.zh: 元興唯有三年，而猥稱四、五，詔書甲子，不與長曆相應。

translations.literal: Yuanxing had only three years, yet they recklessly called it four or five; edict dates in sexagenary cycle did not correspond to the long calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxing had only three years, yet they recklessly called it four or five. Edict dates in sexagenary cycle did not correspond to the long calendar.

sentences.zh: 校籍諸郎亦所不覺，不才令史固自忘言。

translations.literal: The gentlemen who collated registers also did not notice; the untalented clerks naturally forgot to speak.
translations.idiomatic: The gentlemen who collated registers also did not notice. The untalented clerks naturally forgot to speak.

sentences.zh: 臣謂宋、齊二代，士庶不分，雜役減闕，職由於此。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that in the two dynasties of Song and Qi, gentry and commoners were not distinguished, miscellaneous corvée was reduced and lacking—office arose from this.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant considers that in the two dynasties of Song and Qi, gentry and commoners were not distinguished, miscellaneous corvée was reduced and lacking—office arose from this.

sentences.zh: 竊以晉籍所餘，宜加寶愛」。

translations.literal: Privately I consider what remains of the Jin Register should receive added treasure and care."
translations.idiomatic: Privately I consider what remains of the Jin Register should receive added treasure and care."

sentences.zh: 武帝以是留意譜籍，州郡多離其罪，因詔僧孺改定百家譜。

translations.literal: The Emperor for this reason paid attention to genealogical registers; provinces and commanderies mostly escaped blame; he therefore ordered Sengru to revise and fix the genealogies of the hundred clans.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor for this reason paid attention to genealogical registers. Provinces and commanderies mostly escaped blame. He therefore ordered Sengru to revise and fix the genealogies of the hundred clans.

sentences.zh: 始晉太元中，員外散騎侍郎平陽賈弼篤好簿狀，乃廣集眾家，大搜群族，所撰十八州一百一十六郡，合七百一十二卷。

translations.literal: Beginning in the Taiyuan era of Jin, Attendant Gentleman Outside the Regular Establishment of the Rapid Cavalry, Jia Bi of Pingyang, deeply loved household registers; he broadly gathered all clans and greatly searched all kindreds; what he compiled was eighteen provinces and one hundred sixteen commanderies, altogether seven hundred twelve scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning in the Taiyuan era of Jin, Attendant Gentleman Outside the Regular Establishment of the Rapid Cavalry, Jia Bi of Pingyang, deeply loved household registers. He broadly gathered all clans and greatly searched all kindreds. What he compiled was eighteen provinces and one hundred sixteen commanderies, altogether seven hundred twelve scrolls.

sentences.zh: 凡諸大品，略無遺闕，藏在秘閣，副在左戶。

translations.literal: Of all the great categories there was roughly nothing missing; stored in the secret pavilion, copies in the Left Household.
translations.idiomatic: Of all the great categories there was roughly nothing missing. Stored in the secret pavilion, copies in the Left Household.

sentences.zh: 及弼子太宰參軍匪之、匪之子長水校尉深世傳其業。

translations.literal: When Bi's son Feizhi, aide to the Grand Tutor, and Feizhi's son Shen, Colonel of the Long River, transmitted this work through generations.
translations.idiomatic: Bi's son Feizhi, aide to the Grand Tutor, and Feizhi's son Shen, Colonel of the Long River, transmitted this work through generations.

sentences.zh: 太保王弘、領軍將軍劉湛並好其書。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor Wang Hong and Guards General Liu Zhan both loved his books.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Wang Hong and Guards General Liu Zhan both loved his books.

sentences.zh: 弘日對千客，不犯一人之諱。

translations.literal: Hong daily faced a thousand guests and did not violate a single person's taboo name.
translations.idiomatic: Hong daily faced a thousand guests and did not violate a single person's taboo name.

sentences.zh: 湛為選曹，始撰百家以助銓序，而傷於寡略。

translations.literal: Zhan as selection office first compiled the hundred clans to aid ranking and ordering, but suffered from being too sparse and brief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan as selection office first compiled the hundred clans to aid ranking and ordering, but suffered from being too sparse and brief.

sentences.zh: 齊衛將軍王儉復加去取，得繁省之衷。

translations.literal: Wang Jian, Guards General of Qi, again added selection and rejection and obtained the mean between elaborate and spare.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian, Guards General of Qi, again added selection and rejection and obtained the mean between elaborate and spare.

sentences.zh: 僧孺之撰，通范陽張等九族以代雁門解等九姓。

translations.literal: In Sengru's compilation he used the nine clans including Zhang of Fanyang to replace the nine surnames including Xie of Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: In Sengru's compilation he used the nine clans including Zhang of Fanyang to replace the nine surnames including Xie of Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 其東南諸族別為一部，不在百家之數焉。

translations.literal: The southeastern clans were separately made one section and were not counted among the hundred clans.
translations.idiomatic: The southeastern clans were separately made one section and were not counted among the hundred clans.

sentences.zh: 普通二年卒。

translations.literal: He died in the second year of Putong.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Putong.

sentences.zh: 僧孺好墳籍，聚書至萬餘卷，率多異本，與沈約、任昉家書埒。

translations.literal: Sengru loved the classics and gathered books to more than ten thousand scrolls, mostly variant editions, equal to the household libraries of Shen Yue and Ren Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru loved the classics and gathered books to more than ten thousand scrolls, mostly variant editions, equal to the household libraries of Shen Yue and Ren Fang.

sentences.zh: 少篤志精力，於書無所不睹，其文麗逸，多用新事，人所未見者，時重其富博。

translations.literal: In youth he devoted will and energy; in books there was nothing he did not read. His writings were beautiful and unfettered, often using new matters people had not seen; the age valued their richness and breadth.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he devoted will and energy. In books there was nothing he did not read. His writings were beautiful and unfettered, often using new matters people had not seen. The age valued their richness and breadth.

sentences.zh: 集十八州譜七百一十卷；

translations.literal: Collected genealogies of eighteen provinces in 710 scrolls;
translations.idiomatic: Collected genealogies of eighteen provinces in 710 scrolls;

sentences.zh: 百家譜集抄十五卷；

translations.literal: Collected excerpts of the genealogies of the hundred clans in 15 scrolls;
translations.idiomatic: Collected excerpts of the genealogies of the hundred clans in 15 scrolls;

sentences.zh: 東南譜集抄十卷；

translations.literal: Collected excerpts of southeastern genealogies in 10 scrolls;
translations.idiomatic: Collected excerpts of southeastern genealogies in 10 scrolls;

sentences.zh: 文集三十卷，兩台彈事不入集，別為五卷；

translations.literal: Literary collection in 30 scrolls; impeachment matters of the two bureaus not entered in the collection, separately made 5 scrolls;
translations.idiomatic: Literary collection in 30 scrolls. Impeachment matters of the two bureaus not entered in the collection, separately made 5 scrolls;

sentences.zh: 及東宮新記並行於世。

translations.literal: and the New Record of the Eastern Palace all circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: and the New Record of the Eastern Palace all circulated in the world.

sentences.zh: 虞羲字士光，會稽余姚人，盛有才藻，卒于晉安王侍郎。

translations.literal: Yu Xi, courtesy name Shiguang, was a man of Yuyao in Kuaiji, abundant in literary talent, and died as Attendant Gentleman to the King of Jin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xi, styled Shiguang, was a man of Yuyao in Kuaiji, abundant in literary talent, and died as Attendant Gentleman to the King of Jin'an.

sentences.zh: 丘國賓，吳興人，以才志不遇，著書以譏揚雄。

translations.literal: Qiu Guobin, a man of Wuxing, because his talent and will were unmet, wrote a book to satirize Yang Xiong.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Guobin, a man of Wuxing, because his talent and will were unmet, wrote a book to satirize Yang Xiong.

sentences.zh: 蕭文琰，蘭陵人。

translations.literal: Xiao Wenyan was a man of Lanling.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Wenyan was a man of Lanling.

sentences.zh: 丘令楷，吳興人。

translations.literal: Qiu Lingkai was a man of Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Lingkai was a man of Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 江洪，濟陽人。

translations.literal: Jiang Hong was a man of Jiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Hong was a man of Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 竟陵王子良嘗夜集學士，刻燭為詩，四韻者則刻一寸，以此為率。

translations.literal: Prince Jingling once gathered scholars at night, marking candles for poetry; for four-rhyme poems they marked one inch—this was the standard.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jingling once gathered scholars at night, marking candles for poetry. For four-rhyme poems they marked one inch—this was the standard.

sentences.zh: 文琰曰：「頓燒一寸燭，而成四韻詩，何難之有。」

translations.literal: Wenyan said, "Burn through one inch of candle and complete a four-rhyme poem—what difficulty is there?"
translations.idiomatic: Wenyan said, "Burn through one inch of candle and complete a four-rhyme poem—what difficulty is there?"

sentences.zh: 乃與令楷、江洪等共打銅缽立韻，響滅則詩成，皆可觀覽。

translations.literal: He then together with Lingkai, Jiang Hong, and others struck a bronze bowl to set the rhyme; when the sound died the poem was complete—all could be viewed with pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: He then together with Lingkai, Jiang Hong, and others struck a bronze bowl to set the rhyme. When the sound died the poem was complete—all could be viewed with pleasure.

sentences.zh: 劉孝孫，彭城人，博學通敏，而仕多不遂，常歎曰：「古人或開一說而致卿相，立談間而降白璧，書籍妄耳。」

translations.literal: Liu Xiaosun, a man of Pengcheng, was broadly learned and penetratingly keen, yet in office mostly did not succeed; he often sighed, "The ancients might open one discourse and reach minister and chancellor, or in standing talk receive a white jade disc—books are empty things."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiaosun, a man of Pengcheng, was broadly learned and penetratingly keen, yet in office mostly did not succeed. He often sighed, "The ancients might open one discourse and reach minister and chancellor, or in standing talk receive a white jade disc—books are empty things."

sentences.zh: 徐夤，高平人，有學行。

translations.literal: Xu Yin was a man of Gaoping and had learning and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yin was a man of Gaoping and had learning and conduct.

sentences.zh: 父榮祖位秘書監，嘗有罪系獄，旦日原之，而發皓白。

translations.literal: His father Rongzu held the post of Director of the Secretariat Library; once he had a crime and was imprisoned; at dawn he was pardoned, but his hair turned pure white.
translations.idiomatic: His father Rongzu held the post of Director of the Secretariat Library. Once he had a crime and was imprisoned. At dawn he was pardoned, but his hair turned pure white.

sentences.zh: 齊武問其故，曰：「臣思愆於內，而發變於外。」

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Qi asked the reason; he said, "Your servant thought of fault within, and hair changed without."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Qi asked the reason. He said, "Your servant thought of fault within, and hair changed without."

sentences.zh: 當時稱之。

translations.literal: Men of the time praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Men of the time praised him.

sentences.zh: 論曰：二漢求士，率先經術，近代取人，多由文史。

translations.literal: The judgment says: The two Han dynasties sought scholars and put classical learning first; recent ages take men mostly through literature and history.
translations.idiomatic: The judgment says: The two Han dynasties sought scholars and put classical learning first. Recent ages take men mostly through literature and history.

sentences.zh: 觀江、任之所以效用，蓋亦會其時焉。

translations.literal: Observing how Jiang and Ren were effective in service, they probably also met their time.
translations.idiomatic: Observing how Jiang and Ren were effective in service, they probably also met their time.

sentences.zh: 而淹實先覺，加之以沈靜；

translations.literal: Yet Yan was in fact foreknowing, with calm and stillness added;
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yan was in fact foreknowing, with calm and stillness added;

sentences.zh: 昉乃舊恩，持之以內行。

translations.literal: Fang was old favor, upheld by inner conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Fang was old favor, upheld by inner conduct.

sentences.zh: 其所以名位自畢，各其宜乎。

translations.literal: The reason their fame and position each reached completion was each fitting, was it not?
translations.idiomatic: The reason their fame and position each reached completion was each fitting, was it not?

sentences.zh: 僧孺碩學，而中年遭躓，非為不遇，斯乃窮通之數也。

translations.literal: Sengru was a great scholar, yet in mid-life met setback; this was not being unmet—it was the reckoning of poverty and success.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru was a great scholar, yet in mid-life met setback. This was not being unmet—it was the reckoning of poverty and success.
